title: Lock frame classification for first slice
summary: Frames 16-24 and 26-27 define the first Filter Preset implementation target; frames 01-15 are secondary; frame 25 is reference-only; frame 28 is interaction reference only.
rationale: The first slice must prove one coherent Filter Preset architecture before CPT and Integrations frames expand scope.
risks: Secondary frames may look ready, but implementing them now would weaken QA and component reuse.
